name: Abandoned Mine
subtitle: A boarded-up mine entrance. Something lurks within.

description: The abandoned mine exterior is built around a large stone-lined shaft cut into the dry ground. A timber lifting frame stands above it, and a rail track curves through the lower foreground towards mine carts and wooden platforms. Small timber buildings, stacked crates, barrels and equipment surround the opening; one frontage carries a Mine sign. Beyond the workings, a dusty road curves towards open grassland, with scattered rocks and shrubs under a bright sky. The dark shaft and its lifting structure are the scene's centre, set against the sunlit frontier ground around them.
